is_anopheles.evidence: 16 RNA-Seq datasets from four A. arabiensis populations (Mozambique, Asendabo, Chewaka, and Tolay) were analysed (page 3, section 2.3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports Vgsc L1014F (L995F) in An. arabiensis populations (page 8, section 3.8 and Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 reports variant read counts and total read coverage from pooled RNA-Seq data (e.g. 8 variant reads / 32 total coverage), rather than mosquito genotype counts, allele counts, or allele frequencies with sample sizes of genotyped mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: Analyses RNA-Seq data corresponding to An. arabiensis field populations from Mozambique and Ethiopia (Asendabo, Chewaka, Tolay) originally collected by Simma et al. (2019) (page 3, section 2.3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This paper presents a new bioinformatics software tool (FastD) and evaluates it by re-analysing previously published, publicly available RNA-Seq datasets downloaded from the NCBI SRA database (page 3, section 2.3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specifies locations Asendabo, Chewaka, and Tolay in Ethiopia, as well as Mozambique (page 3, section 2.3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years for the underlying mosquito samples are not stated in this paper.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The An. arabiensis RNA-Seq datasets re-analysed here were downloaded from NCBI SRA (accession SRP164719), which originates entirely from Simma et al. (2019) (page 3 and page 11).

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files are not required to determine that the paper re-analyses published data and does not report primary genotype counts.

assessment.summary: This study introduces FastD, a bioinformatics tool designed to detect target-site mutations and overexpressed detoxification genes from RNA-Seq data. The authors validated the tool using publicly available RNA-Seq datasets from NCBI SRA, including Anopheles arabiensis populations from Ethiopia and Mozambique (SRP164719; Simma et al. 2019). Because it only re-analyses existing public sequencing data and reports transcript read coverage rather than extractable mosquito genotype data, it is not eligible.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary empirical study (re-analyses publicly available RNA-Seq datasets from NCBI SRA).
Does not report extractable mosquito genotype data (reports variant read frequencies and read coverage from RNA-Seq).
